prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production background tile atlas for TINIKAMI, an original handheld-inspired spirit battle game.
ONE game-ready sprite sheet, 8 columns by 4 rows, 2048x1024 canvas, equal 256x256 cells. Exactly 32 cells, no words, no grid borders. First 24 cells opaque full-square seamless terrain swatches. Last eight cells isolated props on real transparent alpha.
CRITICAL ART DIRECTION: Extremely QUIET, LOW FREQUENCY, DESATURATED backgrounds so foreground characters and spells dominate. Like restrained 16-bit pixel art drawn at 32x32 logical pixels per tile and enlarged without smoothing. Use large flat matte color areas, only 2–4 closely related muted colors per tile. 90% of every ground tile is uninterrupted plain color. Maximum two very broad subtle irregular patches per tile. No tiny detail, NO dithering, NO texture noise, NO scattered dots, NO grass blades, NO flowers, NO pebbles, NO sparkling water, NO bright highlights, NO white lines. This should look sparse and deliberately under-rendered. Compressed mid-dark values, slate/sage/clay/gray-blue, saturation around 15–25%. Within-tile contrast less than 15 percent. Each variant pair shares exactly the same flat border color, no edge seams or outlines.
Row1: 0 slate-gray garden earth, almost blank; 1 same slate earth variant with one broad faint stain; 2 muted gray-sage moss floor; 3 same gray-sage floor with broad soft-edged pixel patch; 4 desaturated warm sand; 5 same sand with one broad shallow swale; 6 muted dusty-lavender stone; 7 same lavender stone with one large worn patch.
Row2: 8 cold blue-gray packed frost; 9 same blue-gray frost with one broad darker icy shadow; 10 muted clay-ochre ash soil; 11 same clay-ochre ash with broad faint gray patch; 12 quiet gray stone path, very large slab divisions only; 13 quiet desaturated sage footpath; 14 quiet sand footpath; 15 quiet lavender worn paving.
Row3: 16 still muted blue water with only two wide subdued ripple arcs; 17 mid-value frosted blue ice with only two broad low-contrast fracture planes, NO white edges; 18 low-contrast flat dark sage reed mat with only three large leaf shapes; 19 scorched dark clay with two dull rust-red ember patches, no bright flames; 20 muted gray-blue steam haze in two large flat wisps; 21 still gray-blue charged water with two subdued ochre zigzag marks; 22 plain muddy taupe with one large shallow puddle; 23 matte muted aubergine oil with two broad low-contrast slick rings, no iridescent sparkle.
Row4: 24 squat worn slate boulder; 25 simple low dark-jade shrub mound; 26 small weathered wooden wind shrine with a subdued cloth ribbon; 27 small plain lotus stone pedestal; 28 squat carved moonstone boulder; 29 low sandstone boulder; 30 low frosted blue-gray boulder; 31 squat charcoal slag boulder.
Props are top-down/three-quarter battle-map sprites, each fully inside its cell with 32px transparent margins, simple readable silhouette, few large color planes, no tiny ornaments, no glow, no high-value white highlights. They are supporting scenery, NOT focal art. No creatures. Keep exact order and grid.
